public_rationale: Contemporaneous accounts identify Q1 2024 as global equities' strongest first quarter since 2019 and describe AI enthusiasm as a material contributor. They also identify economic resilience, monetary-policy expectations, and risk appetite. Support therefore applies to the ordinary reading that AI helped drive the result. It does not establish AI as the sole or predominant cause, and it does not validate the separate expression of fear about a hype cycle.
limitations: The ranking relies on contemporaneous financial reporting and professional commentary rather than a reconstructed primary index series.
Causal attribution is observational and does not quantify AI's isolated effect.
A predominant-cause reading would remain unresolved.

our_interpretation: Assess the factual statement that Q1 2024 was the strongest first quarter since 2019 and that AI enthusiasm materially contributed.
Driven means a material contributor, not necessarily the sole or largest cause.
Global stock markets means a broad worldwide equity aggregate, not every national market.
The personal expression of fear does not assert a separately measurable outcome and receives no factual verdict.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable reporting or index data establishes the strongest global-equity first quarter since 2019, and contemporaneous evidence identifies AI enthusiasm as a material contributor.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable global-equity evidence disproves the first-quarter ranking, or credible attribution evidence rules out a material AI contribution.
